name: stockmind-web
description: Stockmind Web CRSM worker: ChatGPT reads the canonical GitHub Memo, runs the current Node1-6 methodology sequentially, and writes immutable results back for the webapp to render.

interface.shortDescription: Run CRSM from the GitHub Memo
interface.longDescription: Stockmind keeps ChatGPT Web as the reasoning engine. Invoking Stockmind makes ChatGPT read the canonical Analysis List from GitHub, process the list sequentially, write CRSM results/status back to the repository, and leave the Stockmind webapp to render those durable results.
